findings.summary: Conformance validity binds only to the PR diff identity and task IDs, so merging a changed plan from main under unchanged task IDs can retain conformance evidence that never checked the current requirements.

disposition.reason: Present in the spec on main; conformance binding is fixed in code in PR C and the spec text is amended in PR D

findings.summary: Requiring all three vendors to substitute when all bots fail necessarily includes the author's vendor, contradicting §5.3's independence predicate unless substitute records receive an explicit exception.

disposition.reason: Present in the spec on main; substitution/independence is PR D scope (Tasks 20-22), resolved in its spec amendment

findings.summary: Excluding evidence files does not establish the promised no-loop guarantee because Gemini still reruns the whole code diff on evidence-only pushes and can emit fresh findings requiring another record commit.

The required invalidation of a passing gate after a late Gemini finding remains delegated to unresolved Plan OPEN point 2, while the specified triggers cannot observe that verdict, leaving a merge-blocking requirement undefined.
